detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #25 Packet Transformation Engine Changing a TCP sequence number is easy. Keeping the connection coherent takes state. PH4NTXM's Packet Transformation Engine combines a Rust core with a C NFQUEUE adapter. It validates supported IP packets and maintains mappings for TCP sequence numbers, acknowledgements, SACK, timestamps, and window behavior. Inbound processing occurs before connection tracking. Outbound processing follows destination NAT. After transformation, lengths and checksums are rebuilt. Unsupported layouts or missing required mappings are dropped. Verdict marks connect successful worker processing to later enforcement, and the physical-output guard checks traffic again before release. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
